question: This is a single-line diagram of an electrical distribution system. Filled breaker squares are closed; hollow squares are open (N.O. = normally open). Power flows through closed breakers, transformers and conductors in either direction, from the sources at the top. Ignore equipment ratings. Breaker CB-2 trips open; every other breaker stays as drawn. Which loads lose power? Answer with the load names exactly as written on the diagram, as a comma-separated list in any order.
references: IEEE Std 141 (Red Book): secondary-selective (main-tie-main) distribution systems
IEEE Std 315 / ANSI Y32.2 graphic symbols for single-line diagrams
IEEE C37.2 device function numbers (52 = AC circuit breaker)

question: This is a single-line diagram of an electrical distribution system. Filled breaker squares are closed; hollow squares are open (N.O. = normally open).
